about_heading:
Born and Raised in Quakertown.
This Community is Personal.
about_p1: I grew up here. My family lives here, shops here, goes to school here. When you bring your car to me, you're not dealing with a chain — you're dealing with a neighbor who has a real stake in making sure you leave happy.
about_p2: Before opening Auto Repair by Mike in 2016, I spent years working at dealerships and independent shops across the area. I've seen what customers get charged at big dealerships. I know what things actually cost. And I'm not going to tell you that you need something you don't.
warranty_body: All labor performed at Auto Repair by Mike is backed by a 2-year or 24,000-mile warranty — whichever comes first. Dealership-level coverage from an independent shop you can actually trust.
